facts.quote: ordered by professional contacts tracked in RevenueBase, largest first

facts.fact: Precis is listed as the largest of the 25 agencies, with 539 contacts tracked and 318 verified emails in RevenueBase.
Vertica is listed with 168 tracked contacts and 9 verified emails in RevenueBase.
Web2media is listed with 80 tracked contacts and 13 verified emails in RevenueBase.
Adwise Media A S is listed with 71 tracked contacts and 6 verified emails in RevenueBase.
Kompetencekanalen A S is listed with 59 tracked contacts and 28 verified emails in RevenueBase.
RevenueBase records Precis's employee count as 201-500.
RevenueBase records Vertica's employee count as 51-200, while Vertica's own description states it has 150 employees.
